=== FILE: modules/actions/jobparser/testdata/job_name_with_matrix.in.yaml ===
=== METADATA: format=yaml ===
[SUMMARY] name: test jobs: job1: strategy: matrix: os: [ubuntu-22.04, ubuntu-20.04] version: [1.17, 1.18, 1.19] runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }} name: test_version_${{ matrix.version }}_on_${{ matrix.os }} steps: - uses: actions/setup-go@v3 with: go-version: ${{ matrix.

name: test
jobs:
  job1:
    strategy:
      matrix:
        os: [ubuntu-22.04, ubuntu-20.04]
        version: [1.17, 1.18, 1.19]
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.os }}
    name: test_version_${{ matrix.version }}_on_${{ matrix.os }}
    steps:
      - uses: actions/setup-go@v3
        with:
          go-version: ${{ matrix.version }}
      - run: uname -a && go version
